thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Downgraded by Jefferies Financial Group to “Hold”

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Downgraded by Jefferies Financial Group to “Hold”
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by investment analysts at Jefferies Financial Group from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report released
Several other research firms also recently issued reports on AAPL. New Street Research restated a “sell” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 18th. Needham & Company LLC lifted their price objective on Apple from $220.00 to $260.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Thursday, September 13th. Citigroup dropped their price objective on Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a report on Friday, November 2nd. Bank of America restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $182.00 target price (down previously from $209.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, November 20th. Three investment sell rating, twenty-six have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $212.57.
